description: Phemex perpetual-contract ticker for one symbol (e.g. BTCUSDT): last price, mark and index price, funding rate, open interest and 24h volume, from Phemex's public md/v2 endpoint. Related tools on this server, for a different need: finance_bitfinex_tickers when you need Bitfinex spot ticker for one or more pairs: bid, ask, last; finance_bitget_tickers when you need Bitget spot ticker for one pair: last price, bid/ask, 24h. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
